author: Copilot
body: AccountService.get_account_status() calls BffAccountRepo.get_account_license() directly, but get_account_license() does not map HTTPStatusError/InternalConnectionFailure to CoreException like the previous repo-level get_account_status did. This will leak raw httpx/connection exceptions out of the route (behavior regression). Catch and wrap these exceptions here (or move the try/except into BffAccountRepo.get_account_license()) to preserve a stable CoreException contract and consistent logging.

author: Copilot
body: BffAccountRepo.__init__ no longer accepts slack_notification_service, but there are still call sites passing slack_notification_service (e.g. backend/portal-webbff/tests/unit/test_account.py uses slack_notification_service=AsyncMock()). Those will now raise TypeError at runtime and fail unit tests. Update remaining instantiations to match the new constructor signature (and route Slack usage through ContactService instead).

author: Copilot
body: The module-level logger `log` is defined but never used. Remove it to avoid dead code, or use it to log exceptions/context in send_contact_message (e.g., before raising InternalConnectionFailure).
